integrity: All infinite-dimensional conclusions are supported by the written Gaussian integral, trace completeness, weak-null essential-norm and threshold-expansion arguments; finite diagnostics are not proof.
limitations: One complex dimension, real positive dilation and real nonnegative quadratic amplitude only. General Gaussian-oscillator normal forms might imply subcritical spectral formulas; independent priority review remains necessary.
title: A sharp singular-value boundary layer at the Gaussian Fock dilation threshold
